blocking_prerequisite: freeze Dataset-v4 grouped/temporal split, final taxonomy, development Unknown rotations, and OOF confidence provenance

allowed: future Model B policy meta-evaluation partition
forbidden: classifier training rows without a disjoint meta role
any row whose group overlaps classifier fit, threshold fit, or the other cache subpartition

sample_id_definition: NF3_TON_OBSERVATION_V1 sample_id from the frozen B1 observation contract

strata.eligibility_rule: OOF Basic prediction correct under preregistered confidence/reliability rule; Known class; legal meta partition
OOF Basic unreliable or wrong and at least one OOF single-family/combined legal Evidence view recovers the Known prediction; backend flag never enters request
whole semantic class held out from classifier and threshold development in a development rotation; Full legal Evidence observable; never sealed final Unknown
strata.source_split: development Unknown rotations in future nonleaking meta partitions

balancing_rule: within each stratum and cache subpartition, allocate by largest remainder across eligible core class or held-out rotation and confidence bin; record shortfalls and never duplicate a sample
selection_order: ascending BLAKE2b(sampling_seed || stratum || subpartition || class_or_rotation || confidence_bin || private_group_digest || sample_id)
group_rule: all rows sharing the final private group remain in one cache subpartition; no group crosses policy-demo development and policy meta-evaluation
comparison_rule: Teacher policy and empirical utility-selector baseline are scored on the identical policy_meta_evaluation rows; imitation may use only policy_demo_development
request_projection_rule: sampling stratum, GT, correctness, recovery, Unknown role, split, group, and confidence-bin identities are backend-only and excluded from Teacher input
